theme-roles.reason: Claude Code's custom theme (base dark-ansi) sets these roles: text and accents, message backgrounds, input and dialog borders, status, diff lines, the usage meter and subagent names.

terminal-palette.reason: Claude Code runs in a terminal and uses its sixteen slots, background and cursor; the terminal's own theme sets them.

fixed-ansi.reason: Highlighted code, links (slot 12), diff + and - markers and file previews use fixed ANSI slots that no theme reaches.

light-mode.reason: The theme has no light profile; the custom theme is dark (base dark-ansi) in every mode.

outside-claude.reason: Roles Claude Code's theme has no key for: primitives, interface colours of other components and every value that is not a colour.
